items.title: WP2Shell WordPress Vulnerabilities Exploited in the Wild
items.description: Exploitation of the new WordPress vulnerabilities tracked as CVE-2026-60137 and CVE-2026-63030 started soon after disclosure. The post WP2Shell WordPress Vulnerabilities Exploited in the Wild appeared first on SecurityWeek.

items.title: 15-Year-Old NGINX Vulnerability Lets Attackers Crash Workers and Achieve Remote Code Execution
items.description: A newly disclosed flaw tracked as CVE-2026-42533 affects nginx’s script engine and has been silently exploitable since March 2011, when the map directive gained regex support. Security researcher Stan Shaw reported the bug to F5 SIRT, which coordinated a fix released in nginx 1.30.4 (stable) and 1.31.3 (mainline), along with corresponding patches for NGINX Plus […] The post 15-Year-Old NGINX…
